name: Bad Apples
tagline: Just launched [Bad Apples](https://badapples.net/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — a collection of bite-sized browser mini games you can play instantly
description: Just launched [Bad Apples](https://badapples.net/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) — a collection of bite-sized browser mini games you can play instantly. No downloads, no sign-ups, no friction. I’ve always loved simple games that deliver a quick hit of fun in just a few minutes, so I wanted to build something lightweight and accessible. Most gaming platforms today feel bloated with installs, launchers, ads, and onboarding flows. Bad Apples is the opposite: open the site, click a game, and start playing
